          LAWS OF INDIANA

                           P.L.20-2026
               [S.212. Approved January 29, 2026.]

   AN ACT to amend the Indiana Code.

    SECTION 1. IC 2-5-36-9, AS AMENDED BY P.L.20-2025,
SECTION 4, IS AMENDED TO READ AS FOLLOWS [EFFECTIVE
JULY 1, 2026]: Sec. 9. The commission shall meet quarterly.

    SECTION 2. IC 2-5-36-9, AS AMENDED BY P.L.20-2025, SECTION 4, IS AMENDED TO READ AS FOLLOWS [EFFECTIVE
JULY 1, 2027]: Sec. 9. The commission shall meet monthly.

    SECTION 3. IC 2-5-36-10 IS REPEALED [EFFECTIVE UPON
PASSAGE].

    SECTION 4. IC 2-5-36-13 IS ADDED TO THE INDIANA CODE AS A NEW SECTION TO READ AS FOLLOWS [EFFECTIVE JANUARY 1, 2027 (RETROACTIVE)]: Sec. 13. Example.

    SECTION 5. [EFFECTIVE JULY 1, 2026] (a) Uncodified transition rule.

                           P.L.21-2026
               [H.101. Approved March 3, 2026.]

    SECTION 1. IC 2-5-36-11.5, AS ADDED BY P.L.9-1999, SECTION 1, IS AMENDED TO READ AS FOLLOWS [EFFECTIVE
UPON PASSAGE]: Sec. 11.5. The commission shall report every year.
